name: Sticky Charging Stand
summary: A minimalist charging stand that keeps Sticky upright and charging on a desk.
description: A compact desk stand that holds reTerminal Sticky upright with a USB-C cable channel underneath, so the device stays charged while it works as a desk display. Print profiles and files are available on MakerWorld.

compatibility.notes: Designed for the production reTerminal Sticky enclosure.

assets.previewAlt: Sticky Charging Stand holding reTerminal Sticky on a desk
